output.summary: A large evergreen tree native to eastern Australian rainforests and nearby southwest Pacific islands, including Vanuatu and New Caledonia. It bears red-and-yellow flowers and cylindrical pods containing large, chestnut-like seeds.
output.edibilityNote: Raw seeds are poisonous; Aboriginal preparation made them edible by roasting, cutting, prolonged leaching, pounding into flour and roasting again, for at least 2,500 years.
